rethink: The scouted dropshipping route depends on paid Meta traffic at a $37-51 CPA and ROAS of about 1.65-2.2 (F1, F35), which cannot turn a $5k ad budget into $20k. The ads-resell route faces $15-40/hr freelancers and a small-business market where 52% spend under $1,000 a month (F49, F52). So these routes sell services whose delivery cost is known and whose buyers pay upfront: bulk corporate merch from Printful, managed Shopify support, and AI phone answering for Minnesota winter trades.

routes.title: Twin Cities Corporate Holiday and New-Year Embroidered Beanie Orders
routes.payer: Twin Cities small and mid-size employers, clinics, property managers and clubs buying branded winter gear for staff, clients or events
routes.offer: Custom embroidered logo beanies in bulk (25+ units) with a free mockup, prepaid online, shipped by Printful directly to the buyer. Orders to be placed by about Dec 10 for gifting, plus a January staff/event reorder.
routes.priceAnchor: Printful lists custom embroidered beanies from $15.43 a unit with no order minimum (F40, F41). A 50-unit order at about $32 a unit is $1,600. The $32 is my estimate for what a small business pays for branded beanies.
routes.channel: Cold email through Instantly to Minnesota employers and organisations, using a Brain-built site with an instant mockup and checkout. Cold email costs about $153 per booked meeting (F56), and the buyer pays by card at checkout. Needs about 13 orders, so roughly 2,500 contacts a month at a 3.4% reply rate (F57). Cold email costs and domain setup stay under $1,500 of the $5,000.
routes.fulfiller: Printful, a named print-on-demand supplier. Beanies start at $15.43 a unit before shipping and digitization (F40), with bulk discounts at 25+ units (F26). Brain builds the mockup site and outreach, and Printful starts when each order is paid.
routes.volumeBasis: Estimate: Minnesota employers with 10-250 staff in the seven-county metro, to be built from a business directory such as the state registry or chamber lists.
routes.assumptions: The 25+ unit price at Printful is low enough to leave about a 30% margin after shipping. Decision-makers will buy within days of a cold email in the first half of December. Printful's quoted US delivery of Dec 3-7 for new orders (F42) holds until around Dec 10. Embroidery digitization fees are small per order.
routes.ownerFit: Uses the $5,000 of capital for the site and outreach, and the Minneapolis location for the local-employer buyer list. Needs zero owner hours: Brain handles outreach and orders, and Printful ships.

routes.title: Managed Shopify Customer Support for Small Stores
routes.payer: Owners of small Shopify stores with high holiday ticket volume and no support staff
routes.offer: A flat monthly done-for-you support inbox: AI drafts and sends order, shipping and return replies, and a trained offshore agent reviews and handles exceptions. Billed monthly by card, with the first month paid upfront.
routes.priceAnchor: Ongoing Shopify support plans typically cost a few hundred dollars per month (F80). A flat $349 sits at that level.
routes.channel: Cold email through Instantly to Shopify store owners, opening with a holiday returns and shipping-question pain point. Online returns are expected at 17-19% of sales (F21, F22), so ticket volume spikes in the season. Buyer pays by card at signup.
routes.fulfiller: An offshore support agency or VA team at $6-$14/hour (F29), with AI ticket handling at $0.19-$0.50 per ticket (F29) or eDesk's $0.99 per outcome (F28). Estimated cost is about $110 a client per month.
routes.volumeBasis: Nearly 7 million live Shopify stores (F78) are the pool. The sellable subset is small stores that publish a support email, an estimate of about 7,000 reachable through store directories, to be built from there.
routes.assumptions: Small store owners will pay about $349 a month rather than handle tickets themselves. About 25-30 clients can be signed within the window, since $20k needs roughly 30 clients over two months on average. Support quality holds with AI plus a trained offshore reviewer. Stores will grant helpdesk access.
routes.ownerFit: Uses the $5,000 of capital for outreach and agent onboarding, and no owner hours: AI and an offshore team deliver. Location does not matter, since buyers are online.

routes.title: AI Phone Receptionist for Minnesota Heating and Plumbing Companies
routes.payer: Twin Cities furnace, plumbing and electrical contractors that lose cold-weather emergency calls
routes.offer: A white-label AI voice agent answering missed and after-hours calls on the company's own number, booking jobs and texting the owner. Setup of $750 plus $297 a month.
routes.priceAnchor: Retell names setup fees, per-agent monthly fees or retainers as how agencies bill clients on top of platform costs (F123). The $750 setup and $297 a month are my estimate, to be checked against competing voice-agent resellers.
routes.channel: Cold email and cold-call lists through Instantly to Twin Cities HVAC and plumbing firms during the cold-snap peak, with a live demo call line. Cold email costs about $153 per booked meeting (F56) and the target is about 14 clients, which fits inside the $5,000 budget.
routes.fulfiller: A freelance voice-agent builder at an estimated $300 per setup, running on Retell white-label agents at $0.07-$0.31 a minute (F122). Estimated usage of 400 minutes a month puts running cost at about $60.
routes.volumeBasis: Estimate: HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors in the seven-county metro, to be counted from a business directory and licensing lists.
routes.assumptions: Contractors accept AI answering and will pay a $750 setup fee upfront. A freelancer can build and deploy each agent in days at about $300. Retell resale for this use is within terms. About 14 signed clients give roughly $20k from setup and monthly fees within 90 days.
routes.ownerFit: Uses the Minneapolis location and the winter heating season, and the $5,000 of capital. No owner hours, since a subcontractor builds and AI answers calls.
